overview:
{
  "app_name": "RelayAI MVP",
  "overview": "A single-file HTML contact relationship management application with AI-powered message generation. Users manage contacts with tiered touch frequencies (A/B/C), track overdue follow-ups, and generate personalized outreach messages via Anthropic's Claude API. All data persists in localStorage. Dark-themed, mobile-responsive interface.",
  
  "technical_constraints": {
    "file_structure": "Single HTML file containing embedded CSS and JavaScript",
    "size_limit": "25KB total file size",
    "code_style": "Concise, minimal comments, lean CSS",
    "browser_target": "Modern browsers with ES6+ support, localStorage, fetch API",
    "dependencies": "None - no external libraries or frameworks"
  },

  "views": [
    {
      "name": "login_view",
      "id": "loginView",
      "purpose": "Authentication gate - validates hardcoded credentials",
      "elements": [
        "h1 title 'RelayAI'",
        "form#loginForm with id 'loginForm'",
        "input[type=text] for username with id 'username'",
        "input[type=password] for password with id 'password'",
        "button[type=submit] labeled 'Login'",
        "div.error-message with id 'loginError' initially hidden"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Form submit prevented with event.preventDefault()",
        "Validate username === 'admin' AND password === 'relayai2024'",
        "On success: set sessionStorage.loggedIn = 'true', hide login view, show dashboard",
        "On failure: display error message 'Invalid credentials' in loginError div",
        "Clear password field after failed attempt"
      ],
      "initial_state": "Visible on page load if not logged in",
      "styling": "Centered card, dark background, accent button"
    },
    {
      "name": "api_setup_banner",
      "id": "apiSetupBanner",
      "purpose": "Alert user when Anthropic API key is not configured",
      "elements": [
        "div banner with warning icon/text",
        "message: 'AI features disabled: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in code'",
        "dismiss button (X)"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Display when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY === '' and user is logged in",
        "Hide when dismiss button clicked (set localStorage.bannerDismissed = 'true')",
        "Reappear on page reload if API key still empty and not dismissed"
      ],
      "initial_state": "Check on dashboard load",
      "styling": "Fixed top banner, yellow/orange warning color, dismissible"
    },
    {
      "name": "dashboard_view",
      "id": "dashboardView",
      "purpose": "Overview of contact management status and recent activity",
      "elements": [
        "h2 'Dashboard'",
        "div.stats-grid containing:",
        "  - stat card: Total Contacts (count)",
        "  - stat card: Tier A Overdue (count with red indicator if > 0)",
        "  - stat card: Tier B Overdue (count with orange indicator if > 0)",
        "  - stat card: Tier C Overdue (count with yellow indicator if > 0)",
        "section Recent Activity:",
        "  - ul#activityList with max 10 recent items",
        "  - each li shows: timestamp, contact name, action type (Added/Edited/Message Sent/Deleted)",
        "  - if empty: 'No recent activity' message"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Clicking anywhere on dashboard remains on dashboard (no specific click actions)",
        "Stats auto-calculate from contacts array on render"
      ],
      "calculations": [
        "Total contacts: contacts.length",
        "Overdue by tier: filter contacts where daysOverdue(contact) > 0, group by tier",
        "daysOverdue = (today - lastContactDate) - touchFrequency, return max(0, result)",
        "Recent activity: parse from activity log array, sort desc by timestamp"
      ],
      "initial_state": "Show after successful login",
      "styling": "Grid layout for stats cards, list for activity"
    },
    {
      "name": "contacts_list_view",
      "id": "contactsView",
      "purpose": "Tabular display of all contacts with status indicators",
      "elements": [
        "h2 'Contacts'",
        "button 'Add Contact' with id 'addContactBtn'",
        "input[type=search] with id 'contactSearch' placeholder 'Search contacts...'",
        "table#contactsTable with columns:",
        "  - Name",
        "  - Company",
        "  - Tier (badge)",
        "  - Last Contact",
        "  - Days Overdue",
        "tbody#contactsTableBody with rows for each contact",
        "empty state message 'No contacts yet. Add your first contact!' when contacts.length === 0"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Click 'Add Contact' button: show contact form in add mode",
        "Type in search input: filter table rows in real-time (case-insensitive match on name, company, email)",
        "Click any table row: navigate to contact detail view for that contact",
        "Hover row: visual highlight"
      ],
      "row_data_display": [
        "Name: contact.name",
        "Company: contact.company || '-'",
        "Tier: badge with contact.tier (colored: A=red, B=orange, C=yellow)",
        "Last Contact: formatDate(contact.lastContactDate) or 'Never'",
        "Days Overdue: calculate daysOverdue(contact), display as number, color red if > 0, green if 0"
      ],
      "sorting": "Default sort by daysOverdue descending (most overdue first), then by name alphabetically",
      "initial_state": "Hidden until user navigates to Contacts",
      "styling": "Responsive table, alternating row colors, sticky header"
    },
    {
      "name": "contact_form_view",
      "id": "contactFormView",
      "purpose": "Add new contact or edit existing contact",
      "elements": [
        "h2 dynamic: 'Add Contact' or 'Edit Contact'",
        "form#contactForm with fields:",
        "  - input[type=text] id 'contactName' label 'Name*' required",
        "  - input[type=text] id 'contactCompany' label 'Company'",
        "  - input[type=email] id 'contactEmail' label 'Email*' required",
        "  - input[type=tel] id 'contactPhone' label 'Phone'",
        "  - select id 'contactTier' label 'Tier*' required, options: A, B, C",
        "  - input[type=number] id 'contactFrequency' label 'Touch Frequency (days)*' required min='1'",
        "  - input[type=date] id 'contactLastContact' label 'Last Contact Date*' required",
        "  - textarea id 'contactNotes' label 'Notes' rows='4'",
        "button[type=submit] 'Save Contact'",
        "button[type=button] 'Cancel' with id 'cancelFormBtn'"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "On tier select change: auto-populate frequency field (A=7, B=30, C=90) only if frequency is empty or unchanged from previous default",
        "Form submit: validate all required fields, preventDefault, call saveContact()",
        "Cancel button: clear form, return to previous view (contacts list or contact detail)",
        "If editing: pre-populate all fields with existing contact data"
      ],
      "validation": [
        "Name: required, min 1 character",
        "Email: required, valid email format (use HTML5 validation)",
        "Tier: required, must be A/B/C",
        "Touch Frequency: required, must be positive integer",
        "Last Contact Date: required, valid date, cannot be future date"
      ],
      "modes": [
        "Add mode: empty form, no contactId, on save creates new contact with generated UUID",
        "Edit mode: form pre-filled, contactId in hidden state, on save updates existing contact"
      ],
      "initial_state": "Hidden until user clicks Add or Edit",
      "styling": "Vertical form layout, labeled inputs, validation error messages below fields"
    },
    {
      "name": "contact_detail_view",
      "id": "contactDetailView",
      "purpose": "Display full contact information with action buttons",
      "elements": [
        "h2 with contact name",
        "button 'Back to Contacts' id 'backToContactsBtn'",
        "div.contact-info displaying:",
        "  - Company: value or '-'",
        "  - Email: value with mailto link",
        "  - Phone: value with tel link or '-'",
        "  - Tier: badge (colored)",
        "  - Touch Frequency: value + ' days'",
        "  - Last Contact Date: formatted date",
        "  - Days Overdue: calculated value with color coding",
        "  - Notes: multi-line text or 'No notes'",
        "div.action-buttons:",
        "  - button 'Edit Contact' id 'editContactBtn'",
        "  - button 'Delete Contact' id 'deleteContactBtn' (red/danger style)",
        "  - button 'Generate Message' id 'generateMessageBtn' (accent color)",
        "section Message History:",
        "  - ul#messageHistory list of sent messages",
        "  - each li: timestamp, preview of message (first 100 chars), click to expand full message",
        "  - if empty: 'No messages sent yet'"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Back button: navigate to contacts list",
        "Edit button: navigate to contact form in edit mode",
        "Delete button: show confirm dialog 'Delete [name]? This cannot be undone.', if confirmed call deleteContact(), navigate to contacts list",
        "Generate Message button: check if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY exists, if not show alert 'API key not configured', else navigate to message generation view",
        "Click message in history: toggle expand/collapse to show full message text"
      ],
      "data_display": [
        "All contact fields displayed in read-only format",
        "Message history sorted by timestamp descending (newest first)",
        "Each message shows: date/time sent, full message text when expanded"
      ],
      "initial_state": "Hidden until user clicks contact row",
      "styling": "Card layout, clear sections, prominent action buttons"
    },
    {
      "name": "message_generation_view",
      "id": "messageGenerationView",
      "purpose": "AI-powered message creation with approval workflow",
      "elements": [
        "h2 'Generate Message for [Contact Name]'",
        "div.generation-status with states:",
        "  - initial: 'Click Generate to create message'",
        "  - loading: spinner + 'Generating message...'",
        "  - error: error message with retry button",
        "  - success: hidden (show message preview)",
        "button 'Generate' id 'generateBtn' (initially visible)",
        "div.message-preview (hidden until generated):",
        "  - h3 'Generated Message'",
        "  - textarea#generatedMessage rows='10' (editable)",
        "  - char count display: 'X characters'",
        "  - button 'Approve & Save' id 'approveMessageBtn'",
        "  - button 'Regenerate' id 'regenerateBtn'",
        "  - button 'Cancel' id 'cancelMessageBtn'"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Click Generate button: disable button, show loading state, call generateMessageAPI()",
        "On API success: hide loading, show message preview with generated text in textarea, enable editing",
        "On API error: show error message with details, show retry button",
        "Edit textarea: allow user to modify generated message",
        "Approve button: save message to contact's message history with timestamp, log activity, navigate back to contact detail",
        "Regenerate button: same as Generate (calls API again)",
        "Cancel button: navigate back to contact detail without saving"
      ],
      "api_integration": [
        "Call Anthropic API on generate",
        "Show real-time status during API call",
        "Handle network errors, API errors, timeout",
        "Textarea auto-populated but editable before approval"
      ],
      "initial_state": "Hidden until user clicks Generate Message",
      "styling": "Centered layout, loading spinner, large editable textarea"
    }
  ],

  "navigation": {
    "type": "Sidebar navigation + dynamic view switching",
    "elements": [
      {
        "name": "sidebar",
        "id": "sidebar",
        "items": [
          {"label": "Dashboard", "view": "dashboardView", "id": "navDashboard"},
          {"label": "Contacts", "view": "contactsView", "id": "navContacts"},
          {"label": "Logout", "action": "logout", "id": "navLogout"}
        ],
        "styling": "Fixed left sidebar, dark background (#0f3460), vertical list",
        "mobile_behavior": "Collapsible hamburger menu on screens < 768px"
      }
    ],
    "view_switching_logic": [
      "All views have class 'view' and start with class 'hidden'",
      "Function showView(viewId): add 'hidden' to all .view elements, remove 'hidden' from element with id = viewId",
      "Navigation clicks call showView() with corresponding viewId",
      "Track currentView in global variable"
    ],
    "login_guard": [
      "On page load: check sessionStorage.loggedIn",
      "If not 'true': show only loginView",
      "If 'true': hide loginView, show sidebar, show dashboardView"
    ]
  },

  "data_models": {
    "Contact": {
      "id": "string - UUID generated with crypto.randomUUID() or fallback",
      "name": "string - required, contact full name",
      "company": "string - optional, company name",
      "email": "string - required, valid email address",
      "phone": "string - optional, phone number",
      "tier": "string - required, one of 'A', 'B', 'C'",
      "touchFrequency": "number - required, days between contacts (A default 7, B default 30, C default 90)",
      "lastContactDate": "string - required, ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD)",
      "notes": "string - optional, freeform notes",
      "messages": "array - array of Message objects, default []",
      "createdAt": "string - ISO timestamp of creation",
      "updatedAt": "string - ISO timestamp of last update"
    },
    "Message": {
      "id": "string - UUID",
      "text": "string - full message content",
      "timestamp": "string - ISO timestamp of when message was approved",
      "contactId": "string - reference to parent contact"
    },
    "ActivityLogEntry": {
      "id": "string - UUID",
      "timestamp": "string - ISO timestamp",
      "contactId": "string - reference to contact",
      "contactName": "string - snapshot of contact name at time of activity",
      "action": "string - one of: 'added', 'edited', 'message_sent', 'deleted'",
      "details": "string - optional additional context"
    },
    "SessionState": {
      "loggedIn": "string - 'true' or undefined, stored in sessionStorage",
      "bannerDismissed": "string - 'true' or undefined, stored in localStorage"
    }
  },

  "functions": [
    {
      "name": "init",
      "purpose": "Application initialization on page load",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Check sessionStorage.loggedIn",
        "If not logged in: showView('loginView')",
        "If logged in: showView('dashboardView'), renderDashboard(), checkAPIKeyBanner()",
        "Attach all event listeners for navigation, forms, buttons",
        "Load contacts from localStorage into memory"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "login",
      "purpose": "Handle login form submission",
      "inputs": ["event - form submit event"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "event.preventDefault()",
        "Get username and password values from form inputs",
        "If username === 'admin' AND password === 'relayai2024':",
        "  - Set sessionStorage.loggedIn = 'true'",
        "  - Hide loginError",
        "  - showView('dashboardView')",
        "  - renderDashboard()",
        "Else:",
        "  - Display 'Invalid credentials' in loginError div",
        "  - Clear password field"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "logout",
      "purpose": "Log user out and return to login screen",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Clear sessionStorage.loggedIn",
        "showView('loginView')",
        "Clear currentContact if set",
        "Reset all forms"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "showView",
      "purpose": "Switch active view, hide all others",
      "inputs": ["viewId - string ID of view to show"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Get all elements with class 'view'",
        "Add class 'hidden' to all view elements",
        "Remove class 'hidden' from element with id = viewId",
        "Update currentView global variable to viewId"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "loadContacts",
      "purpose": "Load contacts array from localStorage",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "array of Contact objects",
      "logic": [
        "Get 'relayai_contacts' from localStorage",
        "If exists: JSON.parse and return",
        "If not exists or error: return empty array []"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "saveContacts",
      "purpose": "Persist contacts array to localStorage",
      "inputs": ["contacts - array of Contact objects"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "JSON.stringify contacts array",
        "Save to localStorage with key 'relayai_contacts'"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "loadActivityLog",
      "purpose": "Load activity log from localStorage",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "array of ActivityLogEntry objects",
      "logic": [
        "Get 'relayai_activity' from localStorage",
        "If exists: JSON.parse and return",
        "If not exists or error: return empty array []"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "saveActivityLog",
      "purpose": "Persist activity log to localStorage",
      "inputs": ["activityLog - array of ActivityLogEntry objects"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "JSON.stringify activityLog array",
        "Save to localStorage with key 'relayai_activity'"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "addActivityLogEntry",
      "purpose": "Add new entry to activity log",
      "inputs": ["contactId - string", "contactName - string", "action - string", "details - optional string"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Load current activity log",
        "Create new ActivityLogEntry object with UUID, current timestamp, provided data",
        "Prepend to activity log array",
        "If array length > 100: trim to last 100 entries",
        "Save activity log"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "renderDashboard",
      "purpose": "Populate dashboard with current stats and activity",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Load contacts array",
        "Calculate total contacts: contacts.length",
        "For each tier A, B, C:",
        "  - Filter contacts where tier matches",
        "  - Calculate daysOverdue for each",
        "  - Count where daysOverdue > 0",
        "Update DOM: set text content for each stat card",
        "Load activity log",
        "Get most recent 10 entries",
        "Generate HTML for each entry: timestamp formatted, contactName, action formatted",
        "Update activityList innerHTML",
        "If no activity: show 'No recent activity' message"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "renderContactsList",
      "purpose": "Populate contacts table with data",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Load contacts array",
        "If contacts.length === 0: show empty state message, return",
        "Sort contacts by daysOverdue descending, then name ascending",
        "For each contact:",
        "  - Calculate daysOverdue",
        "  - Create table row with columns: name, company, tier badge, lastContactDate formatted, daysOverdue with color",
        "  - Attach click handler to row: () => showContactDetail(contact.id)",
        "Set innerHTML of contactsTableBody with all rows"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "filterContacts",
      "purpose": "Filter displayed contacts based on search input",
      "inputs": ["searchTerm - string"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Get all table rows in contactsTableBody",
        "Convert searchTerm to lowercase",
        "For each row:",
        "  - Get text content of name, company, email cells",
        "  - Combine and convert to lowercase",
        "  - If combined text includes searchTerm: show row (remove hidden class)",
        "  - Else: hide row (add hidden class)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "showContactDetail",
      "purpose": "Display detail view for specific contact",
      "inputs": ["contactId - string"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Load contacts array",
        "Find contact where id === contactId",
        "If not found: show error, return to contacts list",
        "Store contact in currentContact global",
        "Update DOM:",
        "  - Set h2 to contact.name",
        "  - Populate all contact info fields with formatted data",
        "  - Calculate and display daysOverdue with color",
        "  - Render message history: sort messages by timestamp desc, display each with timestamp and text preview",
        "  - Attach handlers to Edit, Delete, Generate Message buttons",
        "showView('contactDetailView')"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "showContactForm",
      "purpose": "Display contact form in add or edit mode",
      "inputs": ["mode - 'add' or 'edit'", "contactId - optional string for edit mode"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "If mode === 'add':",
        "  - Set h2 to 'Add Contact'",
        "  - Clear all form fields",
        "  - Set lastContactDate to today",
        "  - Clear currentContact",
        "If mode === 'edit':",
        "  - Load contacts, find contact by contactId",
        "  - Set h2 to 'Edit Contact'",
        "  - Pre-populate all form fields with contact data",
        "  - Store contact in currentContact global",
        "showView('contactFormView')",
        "Focus on name field"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "saveContact",
      "purpose": "Validate form and save contact (create or update)",
      "inputs": ["event - form submit event"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "event.preventDefault()",
        "Get all form field values",
        "Validate required fields:",
        "  - name not empty",
        "  - email not empty and valid format",
        "  - tier is A, B, or C",
        "  - touchFrequency is positive integer",
        "  - lastContactDate is valid date not in future",
        "If validation fails: show error messages, return",
        "If currentContact exists (edit mode):",
        "  - Load contacts, find and update existing contact",
        "  - Set updatedAt to current timestamp",
        "  - Add activity log entry: 'edited'",
        "Else (add mode):",
        "  - Create new Contact object with generated UUID",
        "  - Set createdAt and updatedAt to current timestamp",
        "  - Add to contacts array",
        "  - Add activity log entry: 'added'",
        "Save contacts to localStorage",
        "Clear form",
        "Navigate to contacts list",
        "Re-render contacts list"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "deleteContact",
      "purpose": "Remove contact after confirmation",
      "inputs": ["contactId - string"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Load contacts, find contact by contactId",
        "Show confirm dialog: 'Delete [contact.name]? This cannot be undone.'",
        "If user confirms:",
        "  - Filter contacts array to remove contact with contactId",
        "  - Add activity log entry: 'deleted', contactName",
        "  - Save contacts",
        "  - Navigate to contacts list",
        "  - Re-render contacts list"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "calculateDaysOverdue",
      "purpose": "Calculate how many days a contact is overdue for follow-up",
      "inputs": ["contact - Contact object"],
      "outputs": "number - days overdue (0 or positive)",
      "logic": [
        "Get today as Date object",
        "Parse contact.lastContactDate as Date object",
        "Calculate daysSinceLastContact = (today - lastContactDate) in days",
        "Calculate overdue = daysSinceLastContact - contact.touchFrequency",
        "Return Math.max(0, overdue)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "showMessageGeneration",
      "purpose": "Display message generation view",
      "inputs": ["contactId - string"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Load contacts, find contact by contactId",
        "Store in currentContact global",
        "Check if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is empty",
        "If empty: show alert 'API key not configured. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in code.', return",
        "Update h2 to 'Generate Message for [contact.name]'",
        "Reset view state: show Generate button, hide message preview, clear status",
        "showView('messageGenerationView')"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "generateMessageAPI",
      "purpose": "Call Anthropic API to generate personalized message",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "Promise<string> - generated message text",
      "logic": [
        "Get currentContact from global",
        "Show loading state: hide Generate button, show spinner and 'Generating message...'",
        "Construct prompt:",
        "  'Write a genuine, personal outreach message to [name] at [company].',
        "  'This is a Tier [tier] contact - [tier description].',
        "  'Touch frequency: every [frequency] days.',
        "  'Notes: [notes]',
        "  'Write a warm, authentic message that sounds personal, not AI-generated.',
        "  'Keep it under 150 words. Do not include subject line.'",
        "Build API request body:",
        "  model: 'claude-haiku-4-5'",
        "  max_tokens: 500",
        "  messages: [{role: 'user', content: prompt}]",
        "Call fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {",
        "  method: 'POST',",
        "  headers: {",
        "    'Content-Type': 'application/json',",
        "    'x-api-key': ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,",
        "    'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'",
        "  },",
        "  body: JSON.stringify(requestBody)",
        "})",
        "On response:",
        "  - Parse JSON",
        "  - Extract message text from response.content[0].text",
        "  - Hide loading state",
        "  - Populate generatedMessage textarea with text",
        "  - Show message preview section",
        "  - Update char count",
        "  - Return message text",
        "On error:",
        "  - Hide loading state",
        "  - Show error message with details (network error, API error, etc.)",
        "  - Show Retry button",
        "  - Log error to console"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "approveMessage",
      "purpose": "Save generated message to contact history",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Get text from generatedMessage textarea",
        "If text is empty: show alert 'Message is empty', return",
        "Get currentContact from global",
        "Create new Message object:",
        "  id: generated UUID",
        "  text: message text from textarea",
        "  timestamp: current ISO timestamp",
        "  contactId: currentContact.id",
        "Load contacts, find currentContact by id",
        "Add Message to contact.messages array",
        "Set contact.updatedAt to current timestamp",
        "Save contacts",
        "Add activity log entry: 'message_sent'",
        "Navigate to contact detail view",
        "Show contact detail for currentContact"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "checkAPIKeyBanner",
      "purpose": "Show or hide API setup banner based on configuration",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY === '' AND localStorage.bannerDismissed !== 'true':",
        "  - Show apiSetupBanner (remove hidden class)",
        "Else:",
        "  - Hide apiSetupBanner (add hidden class)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "dismissBanner",
      "purpose": "Hide API setup banner and remember dismissal",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
